notes: Card flags broad (4.0%) and gate-closed (100%): '||' x7, ' -*-' x5, ' "%' x3, ' .\n' x2, ' .', ' ::'. Probes: ' .' 0.807, ' "%' 0.782, '^^' 0.602, ' -*-' 0.591, ' ||' 0.380; plain text 0.014. Near misses keep the topics with no such symbols.
